selection: All19 original distinct nonidentical N128 updates. Fixed ranks39/63, four sketch sizes, five shrinkage coefficients and three fixed seeds. No outcome filtering.
scope: Exploratory prediction-only grid. Original production prediction model remains unchanged. Alpha0 is an exact-Gram corrected no-JL control; compare against it before attributing benefit to JL.
